messages.subject: Project Quartz - EXCHANGED
messages.plaintextBody:
Isla, Daniel, Rebecca,

I'm pleased to confirm we exchanged contracts this afternoon on the acquisition of Quartz House at £8,450,000. The 10% deposit of £845,000 has been paid to Marlowe Greaves as stakeholder. Completion is set for 15 May 2026.

Executed contract attached for your records. We'll now finalise the TR1, the rent-deposit assignment and the completion statement.

James
